title: xrRNA-guided Prime Assembly
subtitle: A focused decision portfolio with four separately tracked research objects
research_goal: Demonstrate how a focused Scientific Core run preserves every reviewed research object without treating report files as idea records.
summary: This synthetic bundle contains four typed research objects: a primary symmetric motif panel, a conditional asymmetric-arm assignment, a measurement architecture, and a parked balancing extension. Only the primary object has a dedicated final Idea Report PDF.
scientific_decision: Feature the symmetric structured-RNA motif panel, retain asymmetric arm assignment conditionally, keep the E_A readout as a measurement program, and park the QuadPE balancing extension. This is interface sample content, not a scientific endorsement.

timeline.label: Framing
timeline.detail: The focused decision and non-goals were recorded.

timeline.label: Object review
timeline.detail: Primary, conditional, measurement, and parked objects were separated.

timeline.label: Published
timeline.detail: A synthetic, public-safe portfolio bundle was assembled.

pairwise_selection_impact: No pairwise comparison was required because this was a focused decision run, not a broad discovery portfolio.
